Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Millaisesta työstä sinä innostuisit juuri nyt?




Olisiko työn haastettava ja kehitettävä taitojasi? Tulisiko sen tuottaa tunne, että olet tekemässä jotain merkittävää? Haluaisitko työskennellä työyhteisössä, jossa välittäminen näkyy jokapäiväisissä teoissa ja kohtaamisissa?




Mitä jos sanoisimme, että meillä työskennellessäsi nämä kaikki seikat yhdistyvät yhdeksi – sinun erinomaiseksi työntekijäkokemukseksesi.




🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi Full Stack Data Scientistina

Kanssamme luot asiakkaillemme liiketoiminnallista arvoa ja konkreettista kilpailuetua auttamalla heitä tekemään parempia päätöksiä datan avulla.




Konsultoit, kehität ja viet eteenpäin innovaatioita, jotka auttavat yrityksiä ja yhteisöjä toimimaan fiksusti ja ketterästi. Teet monimutkaisesta yksinkertaista uusimmilla teknologioilla, tehokkaimmilla laskentatavoilla ja parhailla käytännöillä.




Teknologisesta näkökulmasta erilaiset tietovarastot, laskentaympäristöt ja datankäsittelytyökalut ovat osa arkeasi siinä missä pilvipalvelut (AWS, ja Azure ja GCP) sekä ohjelmointikielet ovat erottamaton osa työtäsi.




Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Olemme ylpeitä, kuinka jatkuva oppiminen on luonnollinen osa nitorilaisten päivittäistä asiakasprojektissa työskentelyä. Lue Data Scientistimme, Tuukka Stewenin oppimismatkasta.

Täältä pääset tutustumaan Finnairille toteuttamaamme operatiivisen toiminnan työkaluun.

Data Scientistimme ja projektissa mukana ollut tuleva työkaverisi Jukka kertoo kokemuksiansa projektista ja meillä työskentelystä täällä.

Miltä dataosaajamme työpäivä näyttää – käy vilkaisemassa Eeron tarina.




🤝 Dataliiketoimintamme on yksi kasvualueistamme




Meillä on kokemusta ja osaamista merkittävien toimeksiantojen toteuttamiseen. Asiakastyytyväisyytemme on huippuluokkaa ja kehitämme jatkuvasti toimintaamme.




Katseemme on myös vahvasti tulevassa. Kun tulet työkaveriksemme, uskomme, että se vie meitä taas askeleen eteenpäin – samalla kun katsomme sinulle uraasi ja kehittymistäsi tukevat toimeksiannot, joissa työskentelet yhdessä toisten nitorilaisten kanssa. Meillä saat toteuttaa näköistäsi työelämää yhteiseen tulevaisuuteemme vaikuttaen.




Tuleva data-asiantuntijoiden tiimisi on tiivis startup-henkinen ja uuden oppimista arvostava, jolta löytyy poikkeuksellisen korkeatasoista dataosaamista. Ja jos palaset loksahtavat kohdalleen, tätä joukkoa sinä täydennät juuri sellaisena kuin olet.




✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?




Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on ohjelmointikokemusta, kyky kehittää koodia modernein menetelmin sekä matemaattisen ajattelun mentaliteetti ja taito. Olet kiinnostunut tekoälystä ja koneoppimisesta. Koska ala menee eteenpäin vauhdilla, on tärkeää, että olet innostunut uuden omaksumisesta ja näet haasteet mahdollisuuksina.




Mitä enemmän sinulla on osaamista, se luonnollisesti tarjoaa enemmän mahdollisuuksia heti ensimetreistäsi lähtien. Emme kuitenkaan halua liian tarkkaan määrittää tässä kohtaa, millainen sinun tulisi olla. Palaset kun voivat loksahtaa kohdalleen niin monella tapaa.




🏆Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Me uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.




Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos

haluat työskennellä mielekkäiden toimeksiantojen parissa relevantteja, uusia asioita oppien.
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kouluttautumismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ja -välineet ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita.
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja toisille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja.
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa.
työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa projektista toiseen poukkoilun sijaan.




Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä myös muuten hyvin monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet:




Voit esimerkiksi käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Palkitsemme suorittamasi sertifikaatit bonuksin (500–2000 €/sertifikaatti).
Saat käyttöösi 7100 € työvälineiden hankkimiseen.
Sinulla on mahdollisuus palkalliseen lomaan heti meillä aloitettuasi.
Lisäksi meillä on kattavat henkilöstöedut ja innostavaa yhteistä ajanviettoa.




⭐ Haluaisitko jutella kanssamme tarkemmin, mitä me voisimme sinulle tarjota?

Liity nyt data-ammattilaistemme, koodareidemme, suunnittelijoidemme ja valmentajiemme joukkoon työskentelemään luovassa sekä byrokratiavapaassa työkulttuurissa.




Olisimme todella innostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa.




❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Lähetä meille viesti niin People Partnerimme Ella Raskila (ella.raskila@nitor.com) vastaa kaikkiin kysymyksiisi ja auttaa sinua. Varmistetaan, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.




👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Me haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea sinun osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

Kiehtovat projektit, luontainen uteliaisuutemme ja kollegojesi tuki motivoivat sinua jatkuvassa oppimisessa. Osallistut mielenkiintoisiin koulutuksiin, tapahtumiin ja konferensseihin. Lisäksi voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, yhteisömme kehittämiseen sekä sinua inspiroiviin pro bono –projekteihin.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty – päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Nitorilla äänesi kuuluu.




🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä, Tampereella ja Tukholmassa, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi.




Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

Title: Medior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
Description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technology- en softwareoplossingen die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en meetbare resultaten te boeken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese leveranciers van digitale oplossingen. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie vanwege onze voortdurende focus op innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling. The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Je kan waardevolle inzichten halen uit grote datasets. Als Data Scientist ontfutsel je deze door je vloeiend kennis van programmeertalen als Python en R en visualisatietools als Tableau en PowerBI. Je kan die inzichten communiceren naar stakeholders zodat ze de nodige stappen kunnen zetten. Onze data scientists zijn vaardig in Hadoop & Spark en cloudplatformen als AWS en Azure. Deze tools – samen met je data expertise – zorgen ervoor dat het bouwen van voorspellende modellen, het uitvoeren van hypothesis tests en het uitvoeren van verkennende data-analyse je heel natuurlijk af gaan.

Als Data Engineer zal je:


ruwe data omzetten in bruikbare inzichten en
schaalbare oplossingen
je richten op het ontwerp en de optimalisatie
van data-infrastructuur
processen automatiseren
zorgen voor een naadloze levering van data
microservices ontwikkelen om data lakes
toegankelijker en nuttiger te maken


Je zoekt steeds naar innovatieve manieren om de schaalbaarheid en bruikbaarheid van data te verbeteren. Van de eerste conceptontwikkeling tot de uiteindelijke implementatie—jij ontwikkelt en implementeert data oplossingen die sterke resultaten opleveren en de strategische doelen van onze klanten ondersteunen.

Functie-eisen

We zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologie consulting. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen. Hou je van een uitdaging en vind je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze criteria? Dan kijken we nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Type werk: Hybrid

Locatie: Groningen, NL

Contracturen: 36-40

Type contract: Vast

Opleiding: HBO, WO, PhD

Ervaring: 3-4 jaar

Talen: Nederlands

Je hebt kennis van of ervaring in:

Need: Python, SQL, cloud platform (Azure, AWS, GCP), git, docker

Nice to have: BI, R, Databricks, wiskundige optimalisatie, Specialisatie(e.g. Tabular ML, Computer vision, NLP, Deep Learning), MLOps/devOps, Verantwoorde AI kennis, big data/distributed computing, ETL/ELT, Presentatie vaardigheden

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan.


Wat kun jij van ons verwachten?

  • Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI;
  • 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar;
  • Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen;
  • Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels.


Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit

We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal een afgeronde WO-Masters opleiding met een sterk ICT-component
  • Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken;
  • Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch);
  • Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.;
  • Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.);
  • Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
Testo, with its headquarters in the Black Forest/Germany, is a world market leader in the field of portable and stationary measurement technology. Worldwide, roughly 3900 employees research, develop, produce and market innovative measurement solutions for Testo. The basis for this success, in addition to the highly qualified and motivated staff, is the above-average commitment to a future-oriented development - roughly 10% of the annual concern turnover is invested in Research & Development. With 37 subsidiary companies and over 80 distribution partners, Testo is represented on all five continents.

Role Description

As part of our commitment to leveraging data and AI to drive business value, we are seeking a curious and motivated Data Scientist to join our team.

In this key role, you will transform data into actionable insights, develop machine learning models, and help build the foundation for AI-driven decision-making across the organization. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to solve complex challenges and support Testo's data transformation journey.

Data Science & Modelling


Collect, explore, and analyze data from various business domains to uncover meaningful patterns and trends.
Build, validate, and iterate on statistical and machine learning models that address real business questions.
Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, and time-series forecasting to a variety of use cases.
Translate model outputs into clear, actionable insights, making the complex understandable.


Business Collaboration & Insight Delivery


Work closely with teams across finance, operations, sales, and supply chain to understand their data needs and business context.
Act as a translator between data and business: listen to the business problem, find the right analytical approach, and present findings that stakeholders can act on.
Build dashboards and reports that make insights accessible and self-serviceable for non-technical users.


AI Enablement


Contribute to making our data platform AI-ready — helping to ensure that data is clean, structured, and accessible for AI tools and agents.
Support the development of interfaces (API or MCP server) that allow AI assistants and LLM-based tools to access business data reliably.
Explore and prototype AI/GenAI use cases together with the business and IT teams.


Continuous Learning & Data Culture


Stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, and AI - and bring new ideas into the team.
Help establish best practices for data usage and analytics across the organization.
Actively contributes to a culture where data is trusted, understood, and used to make better decisions.


What We Offer


A meaningful and impact-driven role at the heart of Testo's data transformation journey.
The opportunity to work with modern analytics and AI technologies in an international environment.
A collaborative, learning-oriented culture with room for professional development.
Flexible working arrangements and a supportive team atmosphere.
Competitive remuneration and a comprehensive benefits package.


Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a related field.

Must-Have Experience


2-5 years of professional experience in Data Science or a related analytical field.
Strong hands-on experience with machine learning and statistical modelling.
Proven experience collecting, cleaning, exploring, and analyzing complex business datasets.
Experience presenting analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders and translating data into business value.


Nice-to-Have Experience


Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data stacks
Exposure to AI/GenAI use cases or LLM-based applications in a business context.
Experience in an SAP environment (SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar) can be learned on the job.


Languages: Very good command of written and spoken English.

Personal Attributes


Genuinely curious about data and passionate about finding the story behind the numbers.
A fast learner who picks up new tools, technologies, and domains quickly — and enjoys doing so.
Strong communicator who can explain complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Business-minded: able to understand the "why" behind a question, not just the "how" of solving it.
Collaborative and open, thriving in cross-functional teams and an international environment.
Proactive and self-driven — comfortable working with ambiguity and taking initiative.


You would like to know more about our job vacancy? Please get in touch with Frau Ana Mauricio email: recrutamento@testo.pt.

We are looking forward to receiving your application via Online-Portal.

Wir entwickeln unsere Glücksspielprodukte (wie etwa Lotto, Bingo oder Brieflos) täglich verantwortungsbewusst und mit großem Engagement weiter.

Zur weiteren Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine:n Data Scientist (all genders)

Dein Beitrag zum Glück:

  • Du bist für das Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Implementieren von ML-basierten Lösungen in einer produktionsbereiten Umgebung unter Verwendung bewährter MLOps-Praktiken zuständig.
  • Gemeinsam mit dem Data Engineering Team sorgst du dafür ML-Modelle in bestehende Systeme zu integrieren und Workflows zu optimieren.
  • Weiters stellst du die Skalierbarkeit, Stabilität und Performance von ML-Modellen sicher und kümmerst dich um die Überwachung und Verbesserung der Modelle (inkl. Monitoring und Fehlerbehebung).
  • Strukturiertes, agiles Arbeiten sowie sorgfältiges Testen nach dem Mehr-Augen-Prinzip und eine saubere fachliche wie technische Dokumentation des Codes sind dir wichtig.
  • Zudem bist du stets am Puls der Zeit, behältst Trends und neue Technologien im Auge und gewährleistest die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Modelltrainings- und Deployment-Prozesse.

Darum bist du unser Gewinn:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit IT-Background (HTL/FH/Uni, etc.)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von ML-Modellen sowie der Anwendung von MLOps-Praktiken wie Modelltraining, Modellversionierung, Continuous Integration und Deployment (CI/CD), automatisiertes Monitoring usw.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL, PySpark/Python sowie den gängigen Data-Science-Bibliotheken (z.B. scikit-learn, numpy, pandas)
  • Know-how im Umgang mit Databricks oder anderen Cloud Plattformen von Vorteil
  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie ausgeprägte Teamorientierung
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englisch-Kenntnisse

Mit diesen Technologien arbeiten wir: Databricks (AWS Cloud), Python, PySpark, SQL, dbt, GitLab, MLflow, Jira

Das Gehalt für diese Position richtet sich nach deinen spezifischen Erfahrungen und Qualifikationen. Für diese Position bieten wir ein Jahresbruttogehalt auf Vollzeitbasis ab € 55.000,00

Gleiche Chancen für alle

Jeder Mensch verdient unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung die gleichen Möglichkeiten, seine Karriereziele zu erreichen. Darum sind wir um ein barrierefreies Umfeld bemüht und stellen individuelle Unterstützung für alle Mitarbeitenden sicher.

Wenn du Fragen rund um Gleichberechtigung und Barrierefreiheit hast oder Unterstützung im Bewerbungsprozess benötigst, melde dich jederzeit: glueckimjob@cal-group.at .

Mehr über unser Headquarter

In unserer Zentrale warten neu renovierte Räumlichkeiten mit modernster Ausstattung auf dich – und das im Herzen Wiens. Die S-Bahn-Station Rennweg, das Schloss Belvedere und die Kärntnerstraße sind nur wenige Geh- bzw. Straßenbahnminuten entfernt, damit du die Groß- und Kulturstadt richtig auskosten kannst.

Title: Data Scientist - International Organization
HTML:
Data Scientist - IO

At NTT DATA Luxembourg, we are seeking an experienced data scientist who wishes to integrate the Data Management department of one of the biggest International Organization and who is passionate about delivering insights daily and feature engineering. The ideal candidate will have to help in the data transformation using Big Data & AI methodologies, as well as create and put into place forecasting and statistical models based on relevant data. * Devising and using algorithms and models to mine big-data stores ;

* Performing data and error analysis to improve models ;

* Cleaning data from diverse sources for uniformity and accuracy ;

* Analyzing data for trends and patterns, and interpreting data with clear objectives ;

* Collaborating with other teams to integrate solutions based on the system's data

REQUIRED SKILLS/QUALIFICATIONS :

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in IT, statistics, applied mathematics, or related discipline ;

* Demonstrate +5 years of experience in data science related projects ;

* Experience with the following programming languages: Python, SQL, Scala ;

* Experience with data analytics engine Spark/Hadoop and Dataiku platform ;

* Strong knowledge in machine learning techniques ;

* Good command of data processing tools such as Pandas, Numpy ;

* Proficiency with data mining, mathematics, and statistical analysis ;

* Experience in pattern recognition and predictive modeling ;

* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, research-oriented group that has several projects ;

* Good command of English is mandatory (C1 level) ;

PACKAGE OFFER

* Permanent contract (CDI)

* Meal vouchers

* DKV insurance

* Company car is a possibility

* Career assistance and development trainining

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
We are PHOENIX Pharma, a leading integrated healthcare provider in Europe, and we're excited to invite you to be part of our journey. With a team of approximately 48,000 dedicated professionals, we make a significant impact on healthcare across the continent. Operating in 29 countries, we supply essential pharmaceuticals and health products to pharmacies, doctors, and medical institutions through our 224 distribution centers, serving millions of people every day.




Our international IT Hub in Sofia, Bulgaria, is growing, and we're looking for talented individuals to join us in the Data Scientist position. You'll be part of an international team, working in a vibrant environment that encourages the exchange of knowledge and ideas both onsite and offsite.




Your Responsibilities:




Develop data science solutions for business-critical topics in close collaboration with internal stakeholders.
Build and automate machine learning models and data pipelines.
Contribute to the deployment of models and applications on Microsoft Azure.
Work with engineers and product teams to solve real-world business problems.
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to collaborative development workflows.
Stay curious and up-to-date with trends in AI and machine learning.




Your Requirements:




Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
Solid programming skills in Python and experience with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn.
Experience with SQL and data preprocessing techniques.
Understanding of advanced machine learning techniques (e.g. time series forecasting, parallel computing, other).
Experience with version control tools like Git.
Cloud & DevOps workflows (e.g. CI/CD, Azure ML, Docker).
Data visualization, dashboarding or full stack app development.
Agile project collaboration and stakeholder communication.
Domain expertise in areas such as logistics, supply chain, pricing, or gen AI.
Good communication skills and ability to work in English (B2 or higher).
Team-oriented mindset and willingness to learn.




What We Offer:




26 days paid annual leave + 1 additional for your Birthday.
Health insurance.
Food vouchers.
Flexible working time and options to work from home.
Free parking.
Sports venue pass fully covered.
Learning and development.
Employee discounts for company products and services.




With passion about our product vision in delivering health: creating a health platform that brings together all health services—pharmacies, doctors, and medical supply stores—under one roof. We look for people with the same drive as us. If you recognize this role as a career opportunity where you can make a real difference and be part of an innovative project, we'd love to hear from you!




Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

Title: Data Scientist - Trust & Safety
Description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form video. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy.

The Trust & Safety team at TikTok helps ensure that our global community is safe and empowered to create and enjoy content across all of our applications. We have invested heavily in policy making, product development, and human and automatic moderation to protect billions of users around the globe from harmful content and abusive behaviors.

The mission of data science is to help Trust & Safety make many good decisions using data. As a member of our team, you are instrumental in ensuring that we use data to keep our users and community safe. You will help scope out projects, ideate on new strategies, and most importantly, use data to find insights, diagnose problems and tell compelling stories. You will partner with a variety of stakeholders across operations, policy, product and engineering teams - both locally and globally.

What You Will do:
- Work with large and complex data sets to support project execution and strategic planning
- Design and monitor core metrics; perform root cause analysis to explain drivers
- Collaborate closely with the global Trust and Safety team, proactively providing insights and recommendations and overseeing the macro direction of the business
- Influence stakeholders through data-based recommendations and mobilize cross-functional teams by telling compelling stories with data to drive business impact and innovative breakthrough
- Use data and insights to form best-in-class heuristics to proactively detect and disarm safety incidents
- Develop metrics and visualization tools to evaluate risks of the platform and the impact of safety strategies

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics or quantitative analysis
- Experience working with SQL, ETL, R/Python, Tableau, Excel
- Experience building data infrastructure and implementing reporting solutions
- Experience with creating data visualizations to communicate metric performance
- Independently design, research, develop and apply ML/AI solutions to solve business problems, including prediction, optimization, segmentation and so on. Build evaluation systems for outputs to minimise error and bias and identify root causes such as limitations with model's training data / context window.
- Ability to solve problems using quantitative approaches, strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences to communicate complex concepts and analytical results to drive business impact, and proficiency in English as a working language
- Degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering)

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience of working in online content platforms, Trust & Safety or risk management
- Experience working with international partners in different time zones
- Demonstrated experience using AI tools and emerging technologies to generate insights, improve workflows and develop new capabilities
- Passion for social technology products and a curiosity to learn and grow with a fast paced company

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​


About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.





Job Description



ABOUT US:

Reporting to the Head of Quants you will be working closely with your colleagues in Quants but also various product owners, developers and traders company wide. Our department is responsible for creating predictive models for both pre-match and in-play betting markets in various sports. This typically requires cleaning up, visualizing, analyzing and interpreting relevant data, as well as implementing the created models in Java and testing them. Publishing and maintaining these Java libraries is also one of our responsibilities. Furthermore, we are providing various data analysis or generally math related tasks on demand.







THE CHALLENGE:



Learn how predictive models look like in a betting context and build models on your own.
Support the team in maintaining the codebase.
Analyze/evaluate/optimize existing predictive models as model co-owner.
Research new methods for future applications.





ABOUT YOU:



Required:



Master’s degree or equivalent/higher qualification in one of the following disciplines: Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Software Engineering or a closely related field.
Experienced in predictive modelling, with a deep understanding of data analysis and modelling techniques such as GLMs, Time-Series Analysis, Bayesian Statistics, MCMC, neural networks, etc.
Very strong skills in R or python.
Advanced coding and analytical skills.
Strong communication skills, fluency in English.
Creative thinking, keen to further refine systems and processes.
Highly self-motivated, leading by example and enthusiasm.
Being a team player, with the ability to work with new teams immediately.
Strong interpersonal skills.

Preferred:



Experience in object-oriented programming, preferably Java.
Experience with Gitlab, Jira & Confluence.
Experience with SQL.





OUR OFFER:   



A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding.
Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan.
Opportunity to develop yourself within an inspiring and fast-growing company with our Career framework possibilities.
Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants.
Global Employee Assistance Programme.
Calm and Reulay app (managing stress, maintaining focus, improving sleep, building resilience).
Online training videos.
Flexible working hours.

The minimum monthly salary for this position is according to the Collective Bargaining Agreement, overpayment will be considered depending on qualifications and working experience.







While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation — both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a hybrid model, with team members working in the office four days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

Title: Data Scientist – TV-Insight
Description:
Are you passionate about creating innovative data-driven products that reshape industries?

TV-Insight is an exciting digital spin-off within Red Bull, located in Elsbethen (Austria), dedicated to revolutionizing the TV measurement and advertisement industry. As a Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of creating and improving the analytical foundation of our novel product, capable of handling multiple millions of classification tasks every second. Working alongside a team of talented data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you will play a key role in defining the success of a state-of-the-art analytics product.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

Model Ownership & Production Deployment

You take ownership of the development and deployment of machine learning models for a dedicated TV-Insight market. This includes building and improving real-time machine learning applications as well as developing model components that feed into real-time projection processing. Working closely with a highly specialized team of engineers and data analysts, you ensure a strong understanding of the technical implementation while setting the highest standards for statistical modelling, creating direct business impact from day one.

Exploratory Analysis, Model Understanding & Communication

You conduct thorough exploratory data analyses to evaluate input data and gain a deep understanding of model behaviour and performance. In both research tasks and day-to-day work, you uphold best practices in modelling approaches and production-quality code. You communicate your insights in a clear and accessible way through dashboards and reports, enabling data-driven decision-making for management and key stakeholders.

Continuous Innovation & Technical Excellence

You continuously stay up to date with technological and industry developments to expand your skill set and strengthen your ability to innovate. You critically assess the potential of new methods, tools, and trends, and proactively implement your own ideas in small-scale experiments to test and validate their expected benefits before scaling them into production.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


Master’s degree or PhD in a highly quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
3+ years of professional experience in quantitative analytics, data science, or applied statistics.
Strong hands-on experience in statistical modelling using R or Python, with solid experience working with databases and query languages such as SQL.
Proven expertise in applying core statistical methods, including regression, classification, and hypothesis testing, to real-world business problems.
Ability to translate complex analytical results into clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards using tools such as ggplot, R Shiny, or Data Studio.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.


Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is € 2.362 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary.

As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

You take ownership of the development and deployment of machine learning models for a dedicated TV-Insight market. This includes building and improving real-time machine learning applications as well as developing model components that feed into real-time projection processing. Working closely with a highly specialized team of engineers and data analysts, you ensure a strong understanding of the technical implementation while setting the highest standards for statistical modelling, creating direct business impact from day one.

Exploratory Analysis, Model Understanding & Communication

You conduct thorough exploratory data analyses to evaluate input data and gain a deep understanding of model behaviour and performance. In both research tasks and day-to-day work, you uphold best practices in modelling approaches and production-quality code. You communicate your insights in a clear and accessible way through dashboards and reports, enabling data-driven decision-making for management and key stakeholders.

Continuous Innovation & Technical Excellence

You continuously stay up to date with technological and industry developments to expand your skill set and strengthen your ability to innovate. You critically assess the potential of new methods, tools, and trends, and proactively implement your own ideas in small-scale experiments to test and validate their expected benefits before scaling them into production.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.

Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support business intelligence and reporting needs.

Experience working with large datasets and enterprise analytics platforms.

Strong knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and data integration.

Advanced experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, R Shiny, Plotly, or D3.js.

Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.

Expertise in statistics, econometrics, forecasting, machine learning, geospatial analysis, or related analytical disciplines.

Proficiency in Python and/or R.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Proven ability to manage priorities, facilitate discussions, and drive outcomes independently.

Strong presentation, leadership, and organizational skills.

Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.

Experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ) and/or Master Data Management (MDM) implementations.

Knowledge of Oracle, PL/SQL, Business Objects, Tableau, and other reporting tools.

Experience with Business Intelligence solutions and reporting frameworks.

Knowledge of ITIL, service management, and process management practices.

Familiarity with Stata, C++, MS Access, and Crystal Reports.

Experience implementing data governance, information security, and reporting solutions.

Knowledge of Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) implementations.

Experience with GIS tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS for spatial analysis.

Strong business acumen combined with technical expertise.

Title: Data Scientist - Office of Inspector General
Description:
Summary

The GSA Office of Inspector General (OIG) is seeking a highly motivated and qualified Data Scientist for our Cyber and Data Analytics team in the Office of Investigations.

We are currently filling one vacancy that will be located in one of the following locations, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Washington, DC

Boston, MA

Chicago, IL

Fort Worth, TX

Kansas City, MO

Lakewood, CO

Philadelphia, PA

Tacoma, WA

Learn more about this agency

Duties

As a Data Scientist with the GSA OIG Office of Investigations, you will make use of scientific methodology, processes, algorithms, and systems to collect, analyze, evaluate, and maintain data to yield actionable information; develop data mining and predictive analytics tools to identify indicators of fraud, waste, abuse, and mismanagement; and to support OIG investigations using data analytics, link analysis, and data mining. Some of the responsibilities of this position may include the following duties:


Providing expert design and development of data models and statistical analyses.
Developing new and improved concepts, principles, and techniques to advance the body of business and data analytics knowledge within the OIG.
Collecting and analyzing unstructured and structured data using a variety of methods, including data cleansing, and producing coherent data sets.
Performing data analyses and applying methods including classical statistics, spatial statistics, optimization, supervised and unsupervised modelling as necessary to complete projects.
Converting user stories and project requirements to model design, code, and visualizations. Performing data discovery, data mining, analytic modeling, and visualization to provide insights and drive decisions.
Designing, developing, and deploying data-driven models to solve problems and answer questions using data mining, statistical modeling, analytics, and business intelligence techniques and tools.



The Office of Inspector General (OIG) for the General Services Administration (GSA) is one of the original OIGs established by the Inspector General Act of 1978. The OIGs were created as independent and objective entities within an agency to (a) promote economy, efficiency, and effectiveness in the administration of the agency, and (b) to prevent and detect fraud and abuse in agency programs and operations. The OIGs report to the agency head and Congress through semi-annual and other reports. The GSA OIG operates as an autonomous entity within GSA under a presidentially appointed, Senate confirmed Inspector General who supervises a diverse team of approximately 300 professionals in headquarters' administrative, legal, and operational components and in regional operational offices throughout the country. The GSA OIG is dedicated to protecting the public interest by bringing about positive changes in the performance, accountability, and integrity of GSA programs and operations. Oversight is provided through auditing, inspections and evaluations, and investigations of GSA extensive procurement, real property, and related programs and operations, which primarily support other federal agencies. OIG oversight components report their findings and recommend courses of action to promote efficiency and economy in the GSA’s activities. Applicants are encouraged to review the work and accomplishments of the GSA OIG on our website, https://www.gsaig.gov/.

Requirements

Conditions of employment


US Citizens and National (Residents of American Samoa and Swains Island)
Meet all eligibility criteria within 30 days of the closing date
Register with Selective Service if you are a male born after 12/31/1959



If selected, you must meet the following conditions:


Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service.
Serve a one year probationary period, if required.
Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 5 investigation level).
Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA OIG employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security’s e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment.
Complete a financial disclosure report to verify that no conflict, or an appearance of conflict, exists between your financial interest and this position.



Qualifications

Starting Pay for all locations will be dependent upon the associated GS-Locality Pay Table for that area. If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS DATA SCIENTISTS: All candidates for Data Scientists must meet one of the following basic requirements.


Degree: Mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or field directly related to the position. The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position.



OR


Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown in paragraph A above, plus additional education or appropriate experience.



This position has a positive education requirement: Applicants must submit a copy of their college or university transcript(s) and certificates by the closing date of announcements to verify qualifications. If selected, an official transcript will be required prior to appointment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS TO QUALIFY AT THE GS-13 LEVEL:

In addition to the Basic Requirements listed above, you must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 in the Federal service. Specialized experience is technical data analytics expertise in working with teams to develop data-driven solutions, products and definitions that address program and business challenges. This experience must include: Gathering and compiling data from a variety of business data systems; Consulting with diverse stakeholders and using analysis tools to design and implement data analyses; Using appropriate analytic and statistical software to programmatically prepare data for analysis and clean imperfect data; Translating data analyses into meaningful, easily understood communications; Conducting observational analyses using software and/or programming languages including R, Python, Microsoft Power BI, and SQL to explore/group data, test hypotheses, predict outcomes, and inform decisions; Developing automated data solutions (including dashboards and visualizations); and Providing input to management for decisions on an organization's enterprise data environment and/or data management practices.

Additional information

Candidates will not be hired based on their race, sex, color, religion, or national origin.

Relocation-related expenses are not approved and will be your responsibility.

Applicants are encouraged to make their resume searchable in their USAJOBS.gov profile. This will allow Federal hiring specialists and hiring managers across agencies to find their resume as part of agency recruitment campaigns or staffing searches.

GS-12:

If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, contact the OIG HR point of contact listed on this vacancy announcement.

In the event that this position cannot be filled by the initial selection, alternate selections may be made from this announcement. Management also has the right to not fill this position or to fill additional vacancies through this announcement as needed.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits





A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

You will have access to many benefits including:


Health insurance (choose from a wide range of plans)
Life insurance coverage with several options
Sick leave and vacation time, including 11 paid holidays per year
Thrift Savings Plan (similar to a 401(k) plan)
Flexible work schedules
Transit and child care subsidies
Flexible spending accounts
Training and development



Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

Position is responsible for data collection, data exploration and using large data sets to find opportunities for improving business outcomes. Designs data modeling processes to create algorithms and predictive models. Performs custom analysis. Uses modelling to drive business results with data-based insights and tests the effectiveness of different courses of action.

Location

This position can sit in any of our US offices.

Responsibilities


Works with internal stakeholders and clients to identify opportunities for leveraging organizational data to drive business solutions.
Prioritizes, scopes and manages data science projects for internal stakeholders and clients.
Mines and analyzes data to drive optimization and improvement of product development, marketing techniques and business strategies.
Assesses the effectiveness and accuracy of new data sources and data gathering techniques.
Applies the principles of artificial intelligence, database systems, human/computer interaction, numerical analysis, and software engineering. Identifies patterns and looks for opportunities for optimization.
Develops custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets.
Uses predictive modeling to increase and optimize client opportunities and business outcomes.
Writes computer programs and analyzes large datasets to uncover answers to complex problems.
Develops testing frameworks and tests model quality.
Coordinates with different functional teams to identify and implement models and monitor outcomes.
Develops processes and tools to monitor and analyze modeling performance and data accuracy.
Establishes best practices for data analysis and reporting.
Other duties as assigned.


Skills And Competencies


A specialization in machine-learning, artificial intelligence, cognitive science or data science is preferred. Must be self-driven, curious and creative.
Experience must include creating and using advanced machine learning algorithms and statistics: regression, simulation, scenario analysis, modeling, clustering, decision trees, neural networks, data mining techniques, etc.
Experience with most or all of the following basic data science tools: Python, R, SQL, SAS, NLTK, Scikit-Learn, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, and Jupyter; Basic data science concepts: probability, statistics, hypothesis testing, machine learning, natural language processing, predictive modeling, data visualization; and Big data tools: Hadoop, Azure, etc.
Experience in a professional services or law firm is preferred. Must be adept in agile methodologies and well-versed in machine learning, artificial intelligence and constructing data science pipelines.
Demonstrated presentation skills along with strong business acumen. Ability to communicate actionable insights using data, often for a non-technical audience.


Education


Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, applied mathematics or related field


Years Of Experience


5 years of relevant experience in applying data science techniques to business functions.


Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:


Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
Comply with firm policies and procedures.
Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.


Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment

The firm's work location requirements may be modified at the firm's discretion. Opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion.

Compensation & Benefits

The firm's expected hiring range for this position is $112,879 - $179,481 depending on the candidate's geographic location, experience, skills, educational background, and overall qualifications.

DLA Piper offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, and additional benefits.

Application Process

Interested candidates must apply directly online. Application materials sent via email will not be accepted. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position or participate in the selection process. For accommodation requests, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

No immigration sponsorship is available for this position.

Job duties, requirements, and expectations may be modified at the firm's discretion at any time. This job description does not alter the at-will nature of employment.

We are committed to excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people.

Our clients drive our projects – and no two OW Digital projects are the same. You’ll be working with varied and diverse teams to deliver unique and unprecedented products across industries. Title: Confluent - Data Scientist - Product
Description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Confluent is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That’s the power of data in motion in action—giving organizations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At Confluent, we’re building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure. Our cloud-native offering is designed to be the intelligent connective tissue enabling real-time data, from multiple sources, to constantly stream across the organization. With Confluent, organizations can create a central nervous system to innovate and win in a digital-first world.

We’re looking for self-motivated team members who crave a challenge and feel energized to roll up their sleeves and help realize Confluent’s enormous potential. Chart your own path and take healthy risks as we solve big problems together. We value having diverse teams and want you to grow as we grow—whether you’re just starting out in your career or managing a large team, you’ll be amazed at the magnitude of your impact.

About The Team

The mission of the Data Science team at Confluent is to serve as the central nervous system of all things data for the company: we build infrastructure, metrics, insights, and models. Our team of data scientists is dedicated to designing and deploying advanced data solutions that enable organizations across the globe harness the power of real-time data.

We focus on driving actionable insights and optimizing business outcomes across our customers’ data ecosystems. Our outputs enable data-driven thinking and help optimize every part of the business. There are limitless opportunities for an ambitious data scientist to make an immediate and meaningful impact within our high-growth company.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Scientist at Confluent, you will be a key player in helping define the product roadmap and driving revenue growth at Confluent. You will collaborate with our Product team and cross-functional partners across the organization. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve challenges, unlocking growth and adoption across our suite of products. This role requires a strong blend of technical skills, strategic thinking and leadership skills to influence strategy and investment decisions.

What You Will Do


Own prioritization for your domain and collaborate with product managers, engineers, marketing leads, and other stakeholders to define the data science roadmap for your product area
Work across the org to define and measure success metrics for new features and initiatives
Utilize data to uncover trends, identify opportunities for growth, drive strategic product decisions, and shape product roadmaps
Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to improve product experience
Share actionable insights and recommendations with leadership at various levels, playing a pivotal role in determining Product strategy
Collaborate with other data scientists across our organization to share best practices, learn new analytical techniques, and champion an organizational culture where data is central to decision making
Peer review teammates’ work and provide feedback, working to upskill more junior team members


Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise


5+ years of experience in Data Science/Analytics
Strong proficiency in data manipulation with data querying languages (e.g. SQL) and scripting languages (e.g. Python)
Experience with A/B testing and experiment best practices
Excellent communication skills, and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels of the organization


Preferred Technical And Professional Experience


Experience in SaaS/Product-led Growth companies
Exceptional problem solving skills and analytical skills
Proficiency in data visualization and building dashboards with tools such as Tableau
Experience and knowledge of causal inference, machine learning and other advanced analytical methods

Title: Principal Associate, Data Scientist - Card Intelligence
Description:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. In this role, you will turn complex insights into real-world impact, shaping financial products that serve and protect millions of cardholders daily.

Role Description

Title: Data Scientist II
Description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team

The Applied Research team is a group of data scientists and content specialists who are experts in leveraging machine learning, natural language processing and generative AI models to develop solutions which deliver value to our users and business.

We act as a key driver for innovation, whether it’s in product surface experimentation, metadata generation or model development. Along with Product and Engineering partners, we design solutions and collaborate in cross-functional squads to maximize business impact.

Our areas of impact include content enrichment, representation learning, recommendations, search, translation and many others, applied to diverse media across text, image, and audio. We operate at a scale of hundreds of millions of documents, millions of users and billions of user interactions.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Scientist II with experience developing and deploying machine learning models. You will help design and implement high impact AI and ML systems. We work in cross-functional teams collaborating with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Engineers and Product. We are seeking a curious and collaborative individual with an eye for simplicity, end-end visibility and impact and that is excited about building models using massive amounts of data, using language models and deploying models.

Responsibilities


Focus on a variety of content classification use cases, leveraging everything from traditional NLP to sophisticated LLMs and generative models
Investigate methods of solving our most challenging problems at Scribd, at scale
Collaborate with other Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and ML Data Engineers on cross-functional projects
Leverage any algorithm at your disposal: from classical Scikit-learn and NumPy models to custom Neural Networks in PyTorch to third party LLM APIs
Process massive amounts of data with Python, SQL and Spark
Align with stakeholders through written and verbal communications methods on the approaches and results of projects, while writing detailed, accurate and concise project documentation


Requirements


3+ years of post qualification experience developing machine learning models, working with systems at scale and deploying to production environments.
Proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience building ML pipelines and working with distributed data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Databricks, or similar.
Intermediate level in at least three of these fields: classification algorithms, natural language processing, search, information retrieval, named entity recognition, deep learning, generative models.
Intermediate level or greater experience with SQL or PySpark.
Bachelors or Masters in relevant quantitative discipline including but not limited to Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or another field with a strong quantitative focus.


At Scribd, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $118,000 [minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $184,000 [maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California].

In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $97,000 [minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $175,000 [maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California].

In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $123,000 CAD[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $150,000 CAD[maximum salary in our highest geographic market].

We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package.

Identify and frame high-value problems across functional areas; translate business questions into analytical strategies, experiments, and measurable outcomes.
Develop, test, and deploy predictive models that drive profitable growth and improve operational performance across the enterprise.
Apply modern ML and AI techniques to accelerate development cycles, improve model performance, and deliver new capabilities.
Build production-ready solutions: robust data pipelines, feature engineering, measurement discipline (KPIs, guardrails, and experiment design), model monitoring, and clear, reproducible documentation aligned to best practices.
Communicate with impact: tell the story with data, present recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and influence decisions at senior levels.

Strong hands-on experience with modern modeling tools and methods, including:

SQL for large-scale data transformation and analysis

Strong communication skills—able to present and explain methods, assumptions, tradeoffs, and results clearly.
Experience working with cloud and modern data platforms (especially AWS: S3, EC2, SageMaker; and Snowflake).
Strong grasp of relational databases and experience working with large, multi-source datasets.
Comfort working in Git-based, version-controlled environments; strong documentation practices are required.
Insurance industry experience is helpful but not required.

Strategic Impact: See the direct business value of your models on core growth and profitability levers across the enterprise.
High Visibility: Present directly to the Enterprise Chief Advanced Analytics Officer and other senior executives.
End-to-End Ownership: Own solutions from data wrangling and feature engineering through model development, deployment, and monitoring in production.

Title: Staff Data Scientist
Description:
Global Partners is hiring a Staff Data Scientist to be the senior technical individual contributor for pricing and demand science and applied AI in the Central Data and Analytics Organization. Pricing decisions are made every day across our fuel and convenience store business, and this role builds the models, the experiments, and the AI systems that inform them. The core of the role is demand and price response modeling at scale, delivered as probabilistic forecasts that pricing teams and downstream applications use. You will own the modeling approach, the evaluation that decides whether a model is ready for production, and the path from forecasting toward automated pricing decisions. Measurement is the other half of the role. You will design and analyze pricing field experiments that establish how demand responds to price, and present the results and their limits to leadership and business stakeholders. You will also raise the technical standard of the team: defining how AI and agentic systems are evaluated, setting orchestration and observability practices for production workloads, reviewing designs on work delivered by others, and mentoring other data scientists.




At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is the cornerstone of our commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Your Role, Your Impact

Own demand and price response modeling end to end, from problem framing through production.
Deliver probabilistic forecasts at daily and intraday resolution for pricing and planning use.
Compare candidate modeling approaches against strong baselines and select on evidence.
Define model evaluation and the criteria for promoting a model into production.
Advance pricing from forecasting toward automated price recommendation, with appropriate safeguards.
Design and analyze pricing field experiments, including power analysis and site selection.
Build and deploy agentic and large language model automation for analytical workflows.
Define how AI and agentic systems are evaluated, including harnesses, benchmarks, and reusable skills.
Set orchestration standards for scheduled model and agent workloads.
Establish observability for models and agents in production, covering data quality, drift, cost, and alerting.
Serve as technical design reviewer for pricing programs delivered by other teams.
Partner with machine learning engineering to deploy, version, and monitor production models.
Mentor data scientists and present technical work to leadership and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or related quantitative field required; PhD/Master's degree in Machine Learning, AI, or related discipline preferred.
7+ years of industry data science or machine learning experience, including ownership of production models.
Deep expertise in demand forecasting and price response modeling, including probabilistic output and calibration.
Experience designing and analyzing field experiments, including power analysis and randomization.
Reinforcement learning experience a bonus.
Experience building and deploying agentic and large language model automation.
Experience evaluating AI systems using harnesses and benchmarks.
Expert level Python and SQL, with Git, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.

Title: Data Scientist, Data Science
Description:
About Us

National Grid is hiring a Data Scientist – Data, Business Intelligence & Advanced Analytics. This is a hybrid position and can be based out of Waltham, MA or Northborough, MA.

Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry.

To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business. Data informed decision-making is at the heart of what we do. The data and analytics professionals on the Data & Advanced Analytics team provide the data, analytics and insights that support the New England Electric team with delivering clean, fair and affordable electric power.

In this role, you’ll use advanced analytics, machine learning, and data science techniques to solve complex business challenges and deliver insights that make a real impact.

Job Purpose

In a world increasingly shaped by data, this role is your opportunity to lead the charge in transforming information into impact. As a Data Scientist of Data & Advanced Analytics, you will elevate decision-making and unlock insights that drive innovation, reliability, and progress. You won’t just manage data—you’ll shape the future of how we work, build, and serve.

Key Accountabilities


Employ sophisticated analytics, machine learning, and statistical methods for predictive and prescriptive modelling, forecasting, and simulations to solve business problems
Lead small projects from conception to completion, working with multiple teams of stakeholders directly to understand and address their analytic needs
Assist with research, implementation, and delivery of data products that support the work of the New England Electric Business, including data requests and dashboards.
Assemble small and large individual data sets that meet internal business requirements and are within the overall Electric Data Management (EDM) technology platform
Develop solutions to automate manual procedures and optimize data and solution delivery for end users.


Qualifications

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field.
2+ years’ experience applying data science techniques in a business environment.
Strong skills in:
Python
SQL
Machine learning methods and tools
Relational databases such as Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Curious, collaborative, and motivated to learn.

Preferred


Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field.
GIS programming knowledge or experience.
Experience in the energy industry or another regulated environment.


More Information

Why National Grid?


Help shape the future of Massachusetts' electricity system.
Work on high-impact initiatives that support reliability, affordability, and sustainability.
Collaborate with industry-leading experts across strategy, operations, technology, and regulation.
Gain exposure to major grid modernization and energy transformation programs.
Be part of an organization committed to innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering value for customers and communities.
Work with advanced analytics and enterprise-scale data solutions.
Enjoy a collaborative and innovative team environment.


Salary

$103,000 - $121,000 a year

National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.
